intro: Every Flaz project follows the same four-stage process — so you always know what happens next, who is responsible, and where your project stands.

steps.title: Survey & scoping
steps.body: We visit the site, assess the full scope, and produce a detailed written quotation — fixed price agreed before anything starts. No estimates, no surprises.

steps.title: Dedicated oversight
steps.body: Every project gets a named project manager and site engineer assigned from day one. One person to call, one person accountable for the entire job.

steps.title: Live progress updates
steps.body: Weekly photo reports and progress calls so you always know exactly where your project stands — whether you're on site or overseas.

steps.title: Clean handover
steps.body: A final walkthrough, snag list cleared, and all documentation handed over. We don't close a project until you're satisfied.
